selection: Four saved frames per historical proposal stratum, fixed SHA-256 filename ordering
purpose: Exploratory paired sensitivity check, not independent accuracy evaluation
notes: Higher detector scores can include false positives.
Upscaling does not restore missing image detail.
Contrast enhancement can amplify mesh and noise.
No automatic adoption of the best-looking score.
Saved audit stills contain pre-existing red ROI outlines. Raw means no additional photometric change; this is not clean-original accuracy evaluation.
